text_block_list.text:
See how glad they are to be together?
Thank
you, Trainer!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит
choice_data_list: Are you going to put them all in your room?

text_block_list.text:
Of course! They belong together, so I
can't go
and split them up!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Being together is always better than
being alone!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Like how I always have lots more fun
when I'm
with you!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит
